title: Observability without excess disclosure
requirement: Select metrics, reason codes, and diagnostic records sufficient to explain Personal-data placement and visibility register without unnecessarily disclosing message content, secrets, or identity linkage.
verification_procedure: Inspect successful and failed assessment paths, including temporary artifacts and exports; verify each retained field has an approved purpose and access boundary.
pass_criteria: Consequential decisions remain diagnosable while disallowed private material is absent or explicitly restricted. Absence of telemetry is not interpreted as absence of failure.
accountable_owner_role: Records governance, privacy engineering, and domain assurance
independent_reviewer_role: Independent technical verifier; domain specialist where applicable
applicability_rule: Assess when BVE-C124 is selected and the stated surface exists; otherwise require an approved, reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE decision. Missing specification, unavailable evidence, or a failed test is not non-applicability.

provenance.source_role: Context for the mechanism; not evidence that this control is source-prescribed, implemented, or passed.
